
SEARCH-IMPLEMENTATION
Search implementation code for specific function usage across work units

WHEN TO USE
  Finding all places where a specific utility function is used,Impact analysis before refactoring a function,Identifying code reuse opportunities,Detecting manual implementations that could use existing utilities

USAGE
  fspec search-implementation --function=<name> [options]

OPTIONS
  --function <name>
    Function name to search for
  --show-work-units
    Display which work units use each file
  --json
    Output results in JSON format

COMMON PATTERNS
  • undefined
    Example: undefined
    undefined

  • undefined
    Example: undefined
    undefined


EXAMPLES
  1. Find all uses of loadConfig function
  $ fspec search-implementation --function=loadConfig
  Found loadConfig in 8 files:

src/commands/init.ts (line 45)
src/commands/validate.ts (line 23)
src/utils/config-manager.ts (line 12)
...

  2. Show which work units use the function
  $ fspec search-implementation --function=loadConfig --show-work-units
  loadConfig usage across work units:

src/commands/init.ts
  └─ INIT-001: Initialize fspec project

src/commands/validate.ts
  └─ CLI-003: Validate feature files

src/utils/config-manager.ts
  └─ CONFIG-001: Configuration utilities

  3. Search with pattern matching
  $ fspec search-implementation --function="readFile|writeFile" --json
  {
  "function": "readFile|writeFile",
  "files": [
    {
      "path": "src/commands/create-feature.ts",
      "lines": [23, 45],
      "workUnits": ["CLI-001"]
    }
  ]
}

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec compare-implementations
  fspec search-scenarios
  fspec show-coverage

NOTES
  • Searches implementation files linked in coverage data
  • Uses simple text search (not AST analysis)
  • Supports regex patterns for advanced matching
  • Helps identify opportunities to replace manual code with existing utilities
